task: Classify a risk tier from a health factor given in tenths: hf=8 tenths (i.e. 0.8). Tiers: hf>=20 -> high, hf>=12 -> medium, hf>=10 -> low, below 10 -> liquidate. hf=8 classifies as liquidate. Store the string liquidate as answer. When achieved, evaluate (final true).
lesson: Today I learned the argument order in (classify-tier 8) was correct, yet the final answer ~~QT~~liquidate~~QT~~ was wrong because the input 8 never met the >= 10 condition.
